rows.en: While you were busy desperately exploring this Cube, the Colony Laser was completed.
Veda will handle the controls. It's already aimed right at your base.
It won't miss next time. You're finished. All of it is going as Veda planned. Hahahaha...!!
And what's this plan of Veda's!?
...The unification of "power." The power of every world!!
Veda intends to gather all the "power" that exists in every world under a single, unified consciousness.
But the power you hold couldn't be fully absorbed, because your hearts of justice got in the way.
That's why Veda never made a serious attempt to wipe you out,
but instead analyzed your growth while searching for a way to absorb you completely.
But then, we succeeded in obtaining the memories of each Earth from the Gaia Gate.
Your power was there too, in the form of memories.
In its pure form, without anything as troublesome as a heart of justice.
Veda is analyzing those vast memories right now. Soon, your "power" will be ours.
What have you done...!! What exactly is your objective?
Doing something like that... What exactly is your objective?
You monster...!! Just what are you people after?
What a thing to do... Just what is your goal?
How could you...! Just what is it you're after!?
What!? Just what the hell are you guys after!?
What do you plan to do with that!! What is your goal!?
How could you...!! What are you after!?
Our power's memories, from the Gaia Gate...!? What could you possibly hope to gain by that!?
Quit yammerin' crap nobody can follow!! Just tell me what you're after, dammit!!
What a terrible thing to do...!! Just what is your aim?
What a terrible thing to do...!! Just what is your aim?
What a terrible thing to do...!! Just what is your aim?
How could you...!! Just what is your aim?
How could you...!! Just what is your aim?
We'll unify all worlds and prepare for the coming dialogue. Veda shows us the perfect plan for it.
Now, that's enough, isn't it?
Gaga Squad!!
Gaga...!! There are so many of them...!!
Gaga...!? There are so many of them...!!
Gaga...!? Th-there are too many of them...!!
Gaga...!? There are so many of them...!!
Gaga...!? There are so many of them...!!
Gaga...!? There are so many of them...!!
Gaga...!? There are so many of them...!!
Gaga...!? There are so many of them...!!
Gaga...!? There are so many of them...!!
...What the hell!! All you've got is numbers, huh...!!
Gaga...!? There are so many of them...!!
Gaga...!? There are so many of them...!!
Gaga...!? There are so many of them...!!
Gaga...!? There are so many of them...!!
Gaga...!? There are so many of them...!!
Heh heh heh heh... That's not all, you know? Arche Gundam!!
Yo!! We meet again! But this is the last time, 'cause nobody needs you lot anymore!!
I ain't holdin' back!!
I won't let that happen...!!
I won't let that happen...!!
I'll throw those exact words right back at you!
I won't let you...!!
You're the ones nobody needs!!
That's my line!
I won't let that happen...!!
I won't let you do it!!
That's my line!
I'll throw those words right back at ya!
I'd say the same of you!
I'd say the same of you!
I'd say the same of you!
I'd say the same of you!
I'd say the same of you!
Whoa there...!! The Gaga Squad goes first!!
What!!
...!! We're surrounded!!
...Hm!? Surrounded!?
What!! Are we surrounded!?
We're surrounded!?
Damn it!! We're surrounded!!
Damn!! They've got us surrounded!!
What!? Are we surrounded!?
...!! We're surrounded!?
Tch!! They've got us boxed in!?
Huh!? We went and got ourselves surrounded!?
What!? We're surrounded!?
What!? ...It seems we've been surrounded.

notes.note: Reborns Gundam (Ribbons) explaining the Colony Laser is outside the Cube; labels in this event line up with the 0659.bla script (checked TextIdOffset by TextIdOffset), unlike the shifted labels reported for 0646-0649.
'Tsugi wa hazusanai' = 'It won't miss next time' (implies an earlier shot); subject = the Colony Laser.
Kagikakko-quoted chikara rendered as "power" in quotes, as in earlier slices; same for #0.47 and #0.54.
Seigi no kokoro = 'hearts of justice' (also #0.53, singular).
Sentence runs across #0.49-50; English cut at the same point.

#0.55-69 leader block (TextIdOffset+54+k). 0659.bla Pt_Chara_Check chain 10,9,8,6,7,15,14,5,4,3,13,12,11,2,1 = 00, Wing Zero, God Gundam, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Den-O (Momotaros), Taro, Seven, Ultraman, RX, Rider 1. Voices match (#0.63 W slot is Philip's 'boku-tachi', script name box 198 = W (Philip); #0.64 rough = Momotaros). Same order used for #0.74-88, #0.92-106, #0.110-124.
Mebius slot; source is unusually blunt for Mebius, kept as written.
#0.65-67 (Taro/Seven/Ultraman) identical JP, identical EN; #0.68-69 (RX/Rider 1) use the slightly less formal wording, kept distinct.
Kitarubeki taiwa = 'the coming dialogue' (00 movie concept), lowercase.
Gaga butai = 'Gaga Squad' (no earlier rendering found; also #0.107). Not in glossary.
#0.74-88 leader block; only #0.74 (00, '!!'), #0.76 (God Gundam, stammer) and #0.83 (Momotaros) differ; the rest are identical.
Arche Gundam (Ali): 'irane sonzai' = nobody needs you (Veda now has their power via the Earth's memories).

#0.92-106 leader replies to Ali. Identical JP kept identical: #0.92/93/98 (00/Wing Zero/Mebius), #0.97/100 (Zero/W), #0.102-106 (Taro/Seven/Ultraman/RX/Rider 1). #0.96 (Zeta) source has a trailing line break with nothing after it; dropped.
Ali's 'otto' read as him cutting the heroes off: the Gaga Squad attacks first (next slice: Gaga Trans-Am).
#0.110-124 leader block; #0.121 = Seven (formal). Block continues into story_136 (#0.122-124 Ultraman/RX/Rider 1).

report: 80/80 rows. Speaker labels in 0659 match the script. Leader-variant order from 0659.bla Pt_Chara_Check chain (00, Wing Zero, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Den-O, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, RX, Rider 1), confirmed by voice. Not in glossary: 'Gaga Squad' (Gaga butai), 'the coming dialogue'.
